_comment: Per-artifact-type constraints-profiles (iteration I3). The constraints-checker reads this registry (workspace rule 2); adding or editing a profile = edit this file, NOT the checker. The research profile is implemented separately by research_constraints.py (iteration I4) — it is not a constraints_check profile. Anchors are the artifact-type-specific completeness elements from arch-design section 3; authority_rule is the per-type arbitration rule; the checker enforces anchors-present + authority-consistency + resolve-now-ODP-resolved on the normalized plan-model (ADR #2).

product-spec.authority_rule: spec is the master; authority_chain[0] is the spec

cross_artifact.authority_chain_rule: authority_chain non-empty (schema-enforced); an item's dod_ref doc-prefix must be declared in the authority_chain or be anchor-only (no doc path) — an undeclared doc is an authority contradiction
cross_artifact.odp_rule: every resolve-now ODP must carry a resolution (text); an unresolved resolve-now ODP blocks convergence

anchor_detection._comment: Detection signals per anchor (used by the normalizer to extract the anchors map). Keywords are matched case-insensitively against the source; a heading match (#...) = latch (high-confidence); a prose-only match = semantic-infer (low-confidence); no match = undetected. Keywords are BILINGUAL (English + Chinese) so the inner ring can detect anchors in Chinese-language artifacts (ADR #15); every profile anchor is listed here, an unlisted anchor falls back to its own kebab->space name. Detection stays heuristic — an undetected anchor degrades to a coverage note, never a Blocker (ADR #12, rule 4). Verified against the skill's own docs (the iteration-plan §10 dogfood) and a Chinese-source dogfood (constraints_check_goldens.check_chinese_anchor_detection).
